placements.why: This envelope's content is an infrastructure/database tooling decision — no strata tier exists yet in this repo, and nothing in the empty structure covers organizational-technology choices. Architecture is the named category the org's taxonomy holds for exactly this kind of content, so it is minted fresh rather than folding the decision under an unrelated or absent category.
placements.title: Infrastructure and system-design decisions
placements.frame: What system, platform, or infrastructure choice is being ratified, and what does it change about how the organization builds or runs its technical stack?

placements.title: Replacing infrastructure on a quantified performance case
placements.frame: What measured capability gap is driving the swap-out, and is the commitment (adoption + timeline) keeping pace with the case made for it?
placements.why: All three expressions cohere as one theme: a settled decision to replace the analytics database (src-1), justified by a quantified performance comparison (src-2), operationalized with a committed migration timeline (src-3). This is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding — migration progress, further performance results, timeline slippage or confirmation — not a one-time fact; the 15x figure is evidence for the theme, not a leaf of its own (grain-test: the statistic supports the replacement narrative, it doesn't stand alone). No existing leaf exists in this empty graph to reuse, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata.
